want: to set the two currencies the web app tracks and their display labels, the same way the Android app does
soThat: the web app works for anyone's own pair of currencies instead of being hardcoded to IDR/THB and labeled "Indonesia"/"Thailand"
acceptance: the Accounts view has a Currency settings form with the home currency code, home currency label, foreign currency code, and foreign currency label, defaulting to IDR/Indonesia/THB/Thailand so an existing installation looks unchanged until they are edited
the pair is stored in this browser's localStorage, and missing or unreadable storage falls back to the defaults
a wallet's currency is read from its own account currency, and a wallet that is not in the account list counts as the home currency, instead of a hardcoded wallet id such as BBL
Add Transaction and Edit Transaction route a transaction to the correct internal ledger tab based on the configured foreign currency instead of a hardcoded THB check
the Transactions totals, Balances net-worth row, Insights and Budget section headers, and Calendar currency toggle use the configured pair instead of hardcoded THB and IDR, Thailand and Indonesia
currency symbols and decimal places come from one shared lookup, and a code that is not in the lookup is shown as the code itself
the Budget tab identifies foreign-currency spending by account currency and derives its exchange rate from transfers out of foreign-currency accounts instead of the BBL wallet
